run_wikisql_main: run the main function to generate 32-shot WikiSQL data for multiple random seeds
create_wikisql_dataset: create a WikiSQL dataset instance that wraps the HuggingFace wikisql dataset for text-to-SQL tasks
load_wikisql_dataset: load the wikisql dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of question and human-readable SQL tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits from the WikiSQL dataset with a given seed
